acceptanceCriteria: changing a sourced script helper selects the *_test.sh of every script that sources it, or records an explicit unknown with the reason
a fixture with a two-level source chain covers it
body:
Reported by the lane-ops lane on 2026-10-21. Scripts under script/ source shared helpers, but corvint affected treats each script as an independent unit, so editing a sourced helper does not select the tests of the scripts that source it.
Expected: affected maps `source`/`.` edges between repository scripts, or reports such a change as unknown rather than unaffected.
title: affected does not model shell `source` dependencies between script/ files
